_comment: Known-GGUF filename → canonical tag. Checked (case-insensitive) by backend/llama_models before filename parsing — some publishers drop semantic markers from filenames (e.g. unsloth names MTP quants WITHOUT 'mtp'), which the parser cannot reconstruct. fetch_models.py appends new entries on download/scan. Edit freely; keep filenames lowercase with underscores preserved (matching is done on name.lower()).
